# App Intent

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A declared action the system exposes to Shortcuts, Siri, or Spotlight.

## Scope note

App intents framework entry point; the invocable-action layer of Swift apps.

## Broader

- [PKM Swift](../PKMSwift/)
- [Tool](../Tool/) — generic (ISO 25964)
